2607.28274.title: MORFES: A Benchmark for Productive Inflectional Competence in Modern Greek
2607.28274.paper_summary: Modern Greek is a richly inflected language, yet the language models built for it are evaluated mainly on factual knowledge, and no benchmark is dedicated to their inflectional competence. We introduce MORFES (Morphological Open-class Recognition-and-Formation Evaluation Suite), a benchmark of 500 expert-verified items that tests the recognition and production of Greek inflected forms, favoring lower-frequency lemmas so that a correct answer reflects the rule rather than a memorized form. We make it publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/KIEFERSA/MORFES. We evaluate a range of open language models on MORFES, situating them within the rapidly scaling open-weight ecosystem from LLaMA to Qwen3, DeepSeek-R1, Magistral, and Kimi K2, where multilingual coverage grows but grammatical competence in morphologically rich languages remains under-measured. Among them, Sophea-Genesis-1, a model we developed and release as open weights at https://huggingface.co/KIEFERSA/Sophea-Genesis-1, leads on inflectional morphology while matching similarly sized models in general capability.
2607.28274.paper_summary_zh: 現代希臘語是一種豐富的屈折語言，但為其構建的語言模型主要是基於事實知識進行評估，並且沒有專門的基準來測試它們的屈折能力。<lb/>我們引入了MORFES（形態學開放類別識別與生成評估套件），這是一個包含500個專家驗證項目的基準，旨在測試希臘語屈折形式的識別和生成，並偏好較低頻率的詞條，以便正確答案反映規則而非記憶的形式。<lb/>我們在https://huggingface.co/datasets/KIEFERSA/MORFES上公開提供它。<lb/>我們在MORFES上評估了一系列開放語言模型，將它們置於從LLaMA到Qwen3、DeepSeek-R1、Magistral和Kimi K2的快速擴展的開放權重生態系統中，在這裡多語言覆蓋範圍不斷增長，但在形態學豐富的語言中的語法能力仍然被低估。<lb/>在這些模型中，Sophea-Genesis-1是一個我們開發並在https://huggingface.co/KIEFERSA/Sophea-Genesis-1以開放權重發布的模型，在屈折形態學方面領先，同時在一般能力上與相似大小的模型相匹配。
